title: Rollback after schema evolution
requiredVisibleLabel: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
objective: Roll back after schema evolution; distinguish compatible reversal from required forward recovery.
sourceAcceptance: Compatible rollback preserves data; irreversible changes invoke explicit forward recovery, not a fake successful reversal.
sourceDependency: D-S054 is a source-parent prerequisite, not a claim that native database evolution has been conducted.
preconditions: A modern browser with local HTML, CSS and JavaScript support.
Two fixed v1 synthetic orders, total USD 3500 minor units.
The old v1 contract requires totalCents and assumes USD.
No database, account, endpoint, credentials, framework or Azure subscription.
actions: Choose compatible additive evolution or the declared irreversible-for-v1 currency contract.
Evolve and commit a fixed new v2 write before recovery.
Choose complete, missing-row or unavailable synthetic read observations.
Request application rollback to v1 or explicit forward recovery to v2.1.
Inspect data, read effects, totals, timing, outcome and retained history.
Reset the rehearsal without deleting earlier failed, unknown or safe-abort outcomes.
assertions: Compatible application rollback retains the expanded schema, all three committed orders and USD 4000.
Unsafe v1 reversal of the v2-only currency contract is rejected before exposure, not counted as recovery success.
Explicit forward recovery preserves three interpretable effects, USD 3500 and EUR 700.
A missing committed read is failure even though the durable fixture is unchanged.
An unavailable read is unknown; failures and unknowns stay in the attempted-journey denominator.
Exact actions, fixed enum inputs, authentic immutable states and a 12-decision history bound are enforced.

iac.decisionStage: After genuine behavioral RED and before behavior implementation
iac.reason: Resource-free local synthetic lesson; no cloud, IaC, scaffold, identity, deployment or spending is authorized.

testRuntime.purpose: Existing Node22 tooling only; not production24 certification.

history: Memory only; reset retains all decisions. At 12 decisions the workbook stops. Reload intentionally erases the entire workbook.
limits: Every order, schema change, commit, version, read and timing value is synthetic.
Irreversible means unsafe for the declared old contract; no real down migration or backup restore is modeled.
No real database migration/rollback, native Azure, production24, source-parent or five-nines proof.
B-S060 and D-S060 real data/host acceptance remain separate and unfulfilled.
The published browser helper's known unattended lifecycle limitation remains unqualified; the abandoned prototype is not used.
One frozen S unit; tests, plumbing and refinement earn no additional credit.
